events.focus: First unverified quotient: X4 arithmetic source-address to scale-coordinate Sigma_coord
events.content: More specific later SRT_RH_v1(4).md: Σ_coord exactness not established for actual X4 arithmetic source; Boolean admissibility and final scalar evaluation are downstream. Preserve original source addresses, R4 witness edges and ancestry.

events.focus: Finite same-coordinate R4 component test (toy construction, NOT actual Xi/X4 data)
events.content: In free abelian source address model where R4 is generated by within-coordinate pair-identification edges, ker(Sigma_coord) has rank sum_u(components(G_u)-1). Toy fibre a,b,c,d with edges ab,cd has 2 components and rank 1 kernel; adding bc makes 1 component and rank 0. This isolates a provable exactness obstruction but does NOT establish one in actual X4 Xi arithmetic source.
events.evidence: Executed /mnt/data/rh_livingmath_run1/fibre_probe.py; results.json. Mathematical assumptions: free Z module on finite source addresses, R4 generated solely by differences of nodes in same coordinate, no further linear relations. Actual X4 representation is not yet loaded.

events.focus: Obsolete X4 branch substituted for current Xi-word zero-route research
events.content: The prior LivingMath RH run event #7/#8 mistakenly promoted old August X4/Sigma_coord representation as current RH frontier. Current October 2026 route studies actual Xi in SRT as finite words, cancellation/zero routes, triangle loops, residual paths, theta-source scaling and sign of transported pair terms. Old X4 toy results are archival only and must not be presented as current proof progress.
events.evidence: Latest SymSeq RH conversation reconstructed from 2026-10-18 through DIAG-008 2026-10-24. Key facts: loops also off critical line; residual closure unproved; DIAG-008 positive source yields negative pair contribution after theta observer.

events.focus: CURRENT: Xi-word zero-route residuals and source-coupled theta weights (October 2026 DIAG-008)
events.content: After canceling exact local loops, compare remaining route geometry and coupled residuals at h=0 vs h≠0, without sign-preservation assumption and without reintroducing old X4 carrier. Require genuine Xi source contributions and a zero-route invariant discriminating off-line simultaneous R=Q=0.

events.focus: Xi word zero-route coupling: Cauchy-Riemann transverse mean identity
events.content: For Xi(z)=xi(1/2+z), z=h+it, functional equation and real-type imply Xi(-h+it)=conj Xi(h+it). Thus Xi(h+it)=R(h,t)+i h Q(h,t), with Q(h,t)=-(1/h)∫_0^h ∂_t R(x,t)dx and Q(0,t)=-∂_t R(0,t). Hence off-axis zero h≠0 requires R(h,t)=0 and a zero mean of transverse ∂_t R; in particular some x between 0 and h has ∂_t R(x,t)=0. The identity is exact but does not rule out off-axis zeros, and does not impose positivity of individual theta-pair terms. Test whether theta-route exact loop removals respect this coupled identity.
events.evidence: Analytic derivation from ξ functional equation, conjugation and Cauchy-Riemann; mpmath 35 digit check at h=0.2,t=14.13 agrees to ~3e-39; actual Xi zero-route residue comparison still pending.

events.focus: Pointwise zero loop does not preserve Xi analytic-germ data under deletion
events.content: Minimal symmetry-preserving analytic counterexample: z0=1/5+3i/2, L(z)=(z²-z0²)(z²-conj(z0)²) is entire, even, real-coefficient; L(z0)=0 but L'(z0)=-18/5+12i/25 ≠0. Removing a loop zero only at z0 leaves pointwise sum unchanged but changes derivative, so its Cauchy-Riemann transverse residue data need not survive. This is generic analytic toy obstruction, not a claim the actual theta Xi loops behave that way. Gate: verify whether real Xi route loop is identically zero as function/germ, or pointwise zero with derivative ledger.
events.evidence: Symbolic SymPy expansion: L=z^4+(221/50)z²+52441/10000; exact differentiation. Parent #11 current Cauchy-Riemann hypothesis; latest DIAG-008 focus.

events.focus: Actual T49/T54 Xi-route export independent execution: pointwise/germ boundary
events.content: Independently reran uploaded RH_XI_ROUTES_EXPORT_001 reproduce.py in 22.57s. 3 cases x 16384 edges, 8192 adjacent pairs each: CASE-A 0 loops, B 0, C 4 exact point-zero adjacent pairs. Reproduced loops/routes JSON exactly, checks JSON all scientific fields match (runtime differs). CASE-C pointwise-zero pairs have strictly nonzero h,t derivatives; frozen deletion violates analytic germ, while native T54 forbids erasure, and regenerate-from-source preserves original function. Therefore no native SRT bug demonstrated. CR/reflection preservation alone insufficient to license erasure. Xi not proved.
events.evidence: Uploaded RH_XI_ROUTES_EXPORT_001(1).zip, README.md RCA.md loops.json checks.json; independent reproduce.py --out /mnt/data/rh_export_review/reproduced. CASE-C-PAIR-456..459. Actual source T49/T54 and DIAG-008 archived; not full SRT_Final.

events.focus: Actual T49/T54 ordered Xi routes: coarse path geometry fails to distinguish critical vs off-critical
events.content: Read actual exported CASE-A h=0 and CASE-B h=0.001, both 16384 ordered theta edges. Midpoint diagnostics: total path arclength A=0.4971207781883141, B=0.4971207896742864; maximal prefix excursion A=0.1236996490005734, B=0.12369971539239467, both at step 912. Coarse path length and maximum prefix do not discriminate; endpoint differs strongly, but CASE-A finite endpoint is rigorously nonzero by interval and first-zero near value cannot be certified as zero. Float endpoint in script is not rigorous. Do not infer RH or global separability. Native T54 does not erase point-zero loops; no actual reduction occurred. Test concerns two nearby parameters only, not a universal no-go.
events.evidence: Uploaded RH_XI_ROUTES_EXPORT_001(1).zip actual cases.json edge intervals and finite_word_zero_status; diagnostic script /mnt/data/rh_route_diagnostics.py and JSON /mnt/data/rh_route_diagnostics.json. Midpoints ordinary float, only exploratory.

events.focus: Matched-source theta deformation test from actual T54 routes
events.content: Paired all 16,384 CASE-A h=0 and CASE-B h=0.001 theta edges by identical source_address and origin_id. For midpoint complex values, sum of edge changes Δ endpoint = -8.0146624560e-10 + 1.3827189037321e-6 i; L1 total source-edge changes 8.61148317795e-5, endpoint delta modulus 1.3827191360e-6, ratio 0.01605669; 2048 source groups. This demonstrates collective cancellation of 98.39% of absolute changes in the full source-linked path; not a critical-line discriminator, not proof of RH. Data finite difference only and floating midpoint, not interval certified.
events.evidence: Real user-uploaded RH_XI_ROUTES_EXPORT_001(1).zip CASE-A/B edges, /mnt/data/livingmath_source_probe.py, /mnt/data/livingmath_source_probe.json; exact origin/address matching, no loop erasure.

events.focus: LivingMath v0.3.1 semantic audit adversarial four-mode test
events.content: audit_research_shift gave identical verdict needs_independent_check and warnings=[] to four inputs: obsolete X4 revival (violates #9), rebranding failed global arclength (#14), legitimate source-matched theta finite-difference (#15), prohibited pointwise CASE-C loop erasure (contradicts #13). Thus advisory auditor does not semantically enforce existing provenance/current-frontier and forbidden-transform rules; methodological guardrails work only when external LLM proactively applies them. No false verification issued. Do not claim LivingMath autonomous theory improvement. Proposed fix: explicit scoped evidence-backed obligations/closures and structured adversarial audit requiring event IDs and preservation predicates; preserve advisory status and external proof checking.
events.evidence: Direct MCP audit calls this turn; LivingMath prior event #9 #13 #14 #15; server v0.3.1. Four proposals all warnings empty.

schema_sql: CREATE TABLE policies(code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,content TEXT NOT NULL,enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

CREATE TABLE events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,project TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,focus TEXT NOT NULL,content TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,evidence TEXT NOT NULL,parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES events(id))
CREATE TABLE policy_requests(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,code TEXT NOT NULL,content TEXT NOT NULL,enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,approved_at INTEGER,approver TEXT)

CREATE TABLE reviews(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id),verdict TEXT NOT NULL,reviewer TEXT NOT NULL,artifact_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,notes TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE operations(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,details_json TEXT NOT NULL,previous_hash TEXT NOT NULL,entry_hash TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE request_keys(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id),request_hash TEXT NOT NULL)

policies.content: Не подменять обнаруженный механизм готовым DSL или аппаратом без сравнения преемственности.
Интерпретация и перенос внимания; новые фундаментальные операции требуют доказательств.
Аналогии, тексты модели и численные тесты не являются математическими доказательствами.
После провала — RCA и проверяемый контрпример прежде новой эвристики.
Разделять изменение источника, интерпретации и способа проверки.
Совпадение смыслов через известный канал не доказывает независимую передачу новой информации.
